objective: After an explicit Junyan human SELECT, deterministically derive and audit a paper-only 20-day breakout plan, register exactly one pending model-fund order, and expose buy point, simulated fill time, and descriptive PnL without granting real trading authority.
non_goals: Do not select securities or infer a human decision
Do not connect to a broker or create a real order
Do not run or modify the production nightly chain
Do not treat workflow-debug outcomes as method-validity evidence
Do not backdate a prospective simulated fill
dependencies: human SELECT and standing automatic paper-admission authority
forbidden_scope: real broker accounts and real orders
input_contracts: raw settled daily bars bound to source hashes
current settled marks for every existing filled paper position
output_artifacts: paper-only buy point, fill time, and descriptive PnL view
